scope: Minimal successor to the exhausted v12 actual-only repair space. It may release exactly the predicted dash-cap coverage that still hides a second actual solid-core pixel at frozen broadcast coordinate [940,525], while retaining the authoritative dash center rhythm, 2px core-to-inner annulus, predicted-yellow dominance, source identities, thresholds, z-order, and v9/v11 controls.

primary_equal_cap_contraction_sweep.selection_rule: Start from the frozen 1.5px baseline, test 1.25px, then 1.0px, and freeze the first candidate that satisfies every CPU/static predicate. Never skip directly to the largest contraction and never interpolate an untested value.

fallback_equivalent_cap_policy.allowed_behavior: Suppress only predicted cap-fragment writes that would replace a previously rasterized actual-core sample; retain predicted core and inner side bands, 2px lateral inner annulus, dash centers, side-only outer rim, semantic ownership, and actual-before-predicted submission order.

allowed_production_files.allowed_symbols_or_regions: Predicted dash core/inner/outer cap-extension calculation and cap-only non-overwrite primitive emission; no route, phase, ownership, camera, threshold, or draw-order code.
Renderer-only cap diagnostics strictly required to prove selected cap extensions, 2px annulus, side-only outer band, and prior-actual cap suppression.

forbidden_changes: No minimum area, minimum connected pixels, local contrast 4.0, coverage 0.9, luma, probe count, denominator, coordinate, or acceptance-threshold relaxation.
No predicted dash on/off length, period, phase, center position, route point, centerline, lateral offset, endpoint, tick, marker, camera, viewport, scene, asset, UI, or layout change.
No actual core width, actual halo/rim width, actual internal overlap, actual join fill, or other exhausted v12 actual-only repair retry.
No actual-before-predicted z-order change, pass reorder, depth override, post-process repaint, alpha fade, or evidence crop/omission.
No source probe ID/count/order/coordinates, ownership token, association, arbitration, connectivity, reason code, final-LDR pairing, MSAA resolve, blend, or tone-map algorithm change.
No reduction of the 2px predicted core-to-inner annulus, no outer cap extension beyond inner cap extension, and no cap change that repaints or closes a predicted gap.
No regression of predicted yellow dominance, the two repaired silhouette probes, standard/CVD non-color separation, endpoint/tick readability, or v9/v11 control visible-ID sets.
No product exposure, readiness, authorization, GPU execution, capture retry, targeted5/targeted11/formal68 claim, golden, M2, or Beta promotion from this design gate.

required_checks: Validate all six frozen bindings and exact restored renderer/test/binary hashes transitively bound by the exhaustion receipt before editing.
Static diff allowlist is exactly the two renderer files and only the predicted cap calculation/emission regions; the six algorithm receipt post-SHAs remain exact.

Run the ordered 1.5 baseline, 1.25 candidate, then 1.0 candidate sweep in isolated CPU builds and select the first complete PASS; preserve per-candidate source and binary SHAs plus deterministic rerun hashes.

For every candidate, dashOn=18, dashOff=12, period=30, phase and dash center positions are byte-identical; predicted innerCap-coreCap is exactly 2px and outerCap equals innerCap so the outer band remains side-only/non-overwriting.

At [783,413], [892,491], and [940,525], standard and CVD pixel masks each retain an open predicted-core gap and a distinct actual-core component with minimum area >=1.5 and largest eight-connected support >=2; halo pixels cannot substitute.

Bind the algorithm replay's exact ordered 78 visible source IDs, prove every inherited ID is monotonic non-regressing, then union the exact two contrast repair IDs and one connectivity repair ID to exact 81 unique IDs with predicted 69 and actual 12.

The two frozen predicted silhouette probes [855,469] and [879,486] remain >=4.0 final-LDR contrast and predicted yellow remains the last-drawn primary core without a broad cyan/white three-line artifact.

V11 controls preserve exact source digests and ordered visible-ID supersets: player 95 source/at least 89 visible, elevated 83/at least 80, overhead 87/at least 84; actual coverage remains 1.0 and foreign-track/double/unowned remain zero.
The v9 compositing constraints remain PASS: outer rim does not overwrite the inner halo, same-axis/cross-track identities do not alias, and fixed-rim contrast regressions do not return.
Existing renderer, compound visibility, semantic ownership, telemetry, algorithm receipt, v12 gate, and cap-gate fail-closed tests all PASS; total per-track vertices remain <=8192.
No readiness, authorization, PPM, PNG, GPU artifact, product exposure, or acceptance claim is generated by CPU/static completion.
required_cpu_and_static_preflight.implementation_exit: A separately frozen CPU/static implementation receipt may report the selected minimal cap strategy and exact hashes, but does not authorize GPU capture or establish machine/TA acceptance.

future_targeted_acceptance.machine_prerequisite: Fresh-process targeted5 must be separately authorized only after the algorithm, v12 color repair, and this cap implementation each have frozen PASS receipts; machine must be 5/5 with broadcast 81/81/0 and exact 69 predicted plus 12 actual.
future_targeted_acceptance.ta_prerequisite: Only after machine 5/5, independent original-resolution TA reviews 5x7=35 axes, including all three visible actual-in-predicted-gap regions, predicted yellow/dash dominance, two silhouette contrasts, endpoints/ticks, and the three controls without inherited conclusions.
